floor_history.headline: Floor 23->19 and insn count now exact (116==116) by deleting the inherited INLINE_MOVE_ALIASING cheat in favour of a short-typed clamp; the entire residual is now ONE measured allocno-priority inversi

frontier.hypothesis: The residual is a dataflow-PARTITION problem, not a statement-order problem: the original C held one of the two pointers in a differently-scoped variable, so the walk pointer inherited enough references (or the parameter shed enough) to sort first in allocno_compare.
frontier.mechanism: global.c allocno_compare priority = floor_log2(n_refs)*n_refs/live_length*10000*size, with find_reg assigning callee-saves in ascending hard-reg order. Changing which VALUES share a pseudo changes n_refs and live_length together, which is the only axis left after ordering and loop weighting were killed.
frontier.next_probe: Build variants that change the pseudo partition rather than the statement order — chiefly: does the original hold the D_800A3610 base and the table-walk pointer in ONE variable (so the walk pointer inherits the base's early references and long live range, e.g. `var_s0 = D_800A3610; s.a = var_s0[0xF]; ... var_s0 += 5;`)? Score each variant with BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG=1 on tools/gcc-2.7.2/cc1 and read the pri= numbers directly; that is a much finer gradient than the sandbox score, which only reports the binary outcome of the sort. tmp/grind/func_80078654/s1/greg.sh regenerates the dumps with the exact build flags.

frontier.hypothesis: A COMPLETED-C sibling in the same text1b_b.c draw-primitive cluster already exhibits the target's allocation shape (parameter pointer in the higher callee-save, walk pointer in the lower), and its C is direct evidence of the dataflow the original author used.
frontier.mechanism: Matched siblings compiled by the same frozen toolchain from adjacent-style C are the cheapest available ground truth for what pseudo partition GCC 2.7.2 turns into which allocation — the same evidence route mandated by .claude/rules/register-alloc-pure-c.md.
frontier.next_probe: Census the neighbours around src/text1b_b.c lines 900-1100 that build the same S78654 descriptor and call the same func_8007352C / func_8006E480 / SetDrawMode / AddPrim quartet (func_80078824, func_800788B0 and siblings), find one that is COMPLETED-C and holds both a parameter pointer and a walk pointer in callee-saves, and diff its .greg dispositions and BB2_ALLOC_DEBUG pri numbers against ours. One cc1 run per sibling.

frontier.hypothesis: A permuter campaign seeded from the new, materially better base (floor 19, exact instruction count, zero inline asm) reaches the flip where hand-derivation has not.
frontier.mechanism: Random and directed structural mutation explores pseudo partitions that are hard to enumerate by hand; the prior sessions had no such clean seed to start from.
frontier.next_probe: Run tools/permuter_campaign.py against a SINGLE-FUNCTION target.o built from asm/funcs/func_80078654.s + tools/decomp-permuter/prelude.inc (drop the `.set gp=64` line for r3000) so the function sits at offset 0 and the score is the real weighted diff rather than ~340k of branch-address noise. Honour the fresh-seed stopping rule, wait for it IN-TURN with `permuter_campaign.py wait --dir <ws>`, and vet every closing form against the cheat checklist before proposing it.
